briefing: Statues of Jealous Victory: Hidden Law. Olympian advances through mirror-victory hall with living statue lanes and polished judgment floors while the Gate tests whether excellence proves divinity.

missionIntro.speaker: Olympian Titan Voice
missionIntro.text: The field asks for proof. One active Titan enter, and The Laurel-Star Gate will remember how we answer.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Threats emerge to test Laurel Senate Trials: pressure first, revelation only when the field is held.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Hold the lane, read the hazard, and spend movement as if it were blood.

victory.speaker: Olympian Titan Voice
victory.text: The Gate has not yielded. It has recorded that we did not break.

defeat.speaker: Olympian Titan Voice
defeat.text: Fall back before the wound learns our full shape.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: This mission keeps Olympian doctrine intact: Glory unites them in public and divides them in private; every victory creates a jealous shadow.
